description:
The flats have one water source that will not take the enamel off a cup, and something has moved into it.

Ma Cinder does not call them horrors. Ma Cinder calls them the trouble, in the same tone she uses for weather and for her sons.

"Three of mine went for water and two came back, and the one that came back has stopped talking about it, which is worse than if he hadn't. So." She goes back to the pot. "Deal with the trouble. Don't come and tell me about it after. I'm not curious and I don't want the picture in my head with everybody else's."
name: Bog Standard

objectives.desc: Kill 2 tar-pit horrors in the flats (the seeps: Tar Seep, Rust Marsh, The Runoff)
emotes: {who} goes into the seep after it, boots first, which is the only way in.
{who} finds out what tar does to a swing, and adjusts.
{who} drags something out of the water that keeps moving for a while afterwards.
